data.title: 户隐憧子 · 薰衣草私汤的水汽回眸
data.description: 热气蒸腾的露天私汤木桶中，飘浮着淡紫色的薰衣草干花。憧子学姐浸泡在温热的泉水中，水汽将她白皙的面颊蒸腾得宛如盛开的花瓣。她转过身来，长发挽在胸前，眼波流转中尽显成熟学姐罕见的妩媚与羞怯。
data.action: 她转过身来，长发挽在胸前，眼波流转中尽显成熟学姐罕见的妩媚与羞怯
data.lighting: soft wooden lanterns through thick warm mist
data.promptProse: Inside a private outdoor cedar bath infused with dried lavender flowers at night, Touko turns back through the rising warm mist beneath a glowing paper lantern. Steam softens the shadows around her flushed face and gentle gaze.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude in a steaming outdoor wooden tub scattered with floating lavender blossoms, she draws her wet hair forward across her chest and glances back over her shoulder with flushed cheeks under the paper lantern.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed in the deep wooden tub, she gathers her wet dark locks across her bare chest while water gleams over her bare shoulders and collarbones.
